title: NAS security mode command not accepted by the UE

entities.name: SECURITY MODE REJECT
entities.description: Message sent by UE when security mode command cannot be accepted. Contains 5GMM cause indicating rejection reason.

entities.name: 5GMM cause
entities.description: Information element containing cause value indicating reason for security mode rejection.

entities.name: Replayed UE security capabilities
entities.description: IE containing replayed UE security capabilities that UE compares against its latest sent values.

entities.name: UE security capabilities mismatch
entities.description: Cause value #23 set when UE detects altered replayed UE security capabilities IE.

entities.name: security mode rejected, unspecified
entities.description: Cause value #24 used for unspecified security mode rejection.

entities.name: T3560
entities.description: Timer running during NAS security mode control procedure that AMF stops upon receiving SECURITY MODE REJECT.

entities.name: NAS security mode control procedure
entities.description: Procedure for establishing NAS security that is aborted when SECURITY MODE REJECT is received.

entities.name: 5G NAS security context in use before security mode control
entities.description: Security context that both UE and AMF revert to after security mode rejection.

relations.description: SECURITY MODE REJECT message contains 5GMM cause IE indicating rejection reason.
Altered replayed UE security capabilities IE triggers setting cause value to #23.
Receipt of SECURITY MODE REJECT message causes AMF to stop timer T3560.
Receipt of SECURITY MODE REJECT causes AMF to abort the ongoing NAS security mode control procedure.
After SECURITY MODE REJECT, both UE and AMF revert to using previous 5G NAS security context.
SECURITY MODE REJECT message and subsequent messages are protected using previous 5G NAS security context.
